acceptance.given: An identified existing passing replay behavior has an unchanged baseline and the pre-change characterization test has been authored.

oracle.expected: The pre-change test records the baseline-observed passing behavior and separately demonstrates a fault witness against that same production behavior; the guard rejects a production change when either the truthful characterization or distinct witness is absent.
forbidden: A production behavior change without a baseline characterization of the existing passing behavior.
A production behavior change without a distinct fault witness.
Fabricated, post-hoc, or result-only failure evidence accepted as the fault witness.
oracle.observable: The dedicated test source contains separate baseline-characterization and fault-witness assertions, and its pre-change execution distinguishes the passing baseline from the induced defect.

acceptance.then: The change gate has attributable pre-change characterization and an independent fault witness for the brownfield behavior.
acceptance.when: Before modifying the replay production behavior for an existing passing brownfield case, the dedicated characterization selector is run against the baseline and its controlled fault condition.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove or bypass the baseline-characterization assertion and verify that the pre-change guard rejects the incomplete evidence contract.
Remove or alias the controlled fault-witness assertion to the baseline assertion and verify that the guard rejects the absence of an independent witness.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add a pre-change brownfield gate for the repository replay behavior: it must preserve a truthful observation of the existing passing baseline and require a separately executable fault witness before the production behavior may change.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; reverting the gate restores the prior replay implementation while preserving historical artifacts and evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Existing passing brownfield behavior without attributable pre-change characterization and a distinct fault witness becomes behavior blocked from production modification until both artifacts are independently verified.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The unit selector proves a passing baseline characterization and a separate controlled fault witness for the same replay behavior; either missing or aliased proof fails the guard before production behavior changes.
